subject: DAP Dubai - air freight quote
body:
Hi,

please quote 3 pallets of inverters from Hamburg airport to Dubai, 350 kg, 1.4 cbm. We deliver to HAM ourselves, ready 27.11.2026.

Terms are DAP, delivery to our customer's warehouse in Jebel Ali, Dubai, so please include delivery from DXB airport to the door. Cheapest option, EUR.

Best regards
Ole Hansen
Export
Nordlicht Solar GmbH
